agentcheck.noLogin: the claude CLI is not logged in; a new session (a worker's, an isolated test's) stops at the login prompt. Log in with: claude auth login (or /login in a claude session)
agentcheck.authUnreadable: claude auth status --json gave no readable answer; this CLI version may not have the command
agentcheck.noCli: the claude CLI is not on the PATH; without it there is no way to check the plugin. Install Claude Code: https://claude.com/claude-code
agentcheck.noCliLogin: without the claude CLI, there is no way to know whether you are logged in
agentcheck.noCliPlugin: without the claude CLI, there is no way to know whether the {0} plugin is installed
agentcheck.noCliVersions: without the claude CLI, there is no way to compare versions
agentcheck.noJqList: without jq, there is no way to read the claude plugin list
agentcheck.noJqVersions: without jq, there is no way to compare versions
agentcheck.listUnreadable: claude plugin list --json did not return a readable list
agentcheck.noListVersions: without the plugin list, there is no way to compare versions
agentcheck.notInstalled: the {0} plugin is not installed. Install: claude plugin marketplace add <source> and claude plugin install {0}@{0}
agentcheck.disabled: plugin {0} {1} installed, but disabled. Enable: claude plugin enable {0}@{0}
agentcheck.remoteSource: installed version {0}; the source is not a local folder (a git repository, for example), and knowing whether it is current would need the network. To update: claude plugin marketplace update {1} and claude plugin update {1}@{1}
agentcheck.folderDiffers: installed {0}, the source folder has {1}. Update: claude plugin update {2}@{2}
agentcheck.sameCache: {0}, same as the source folder; so is the cache copy
agentcheck.cacheDiffers: the cache copy ({0}) differs from the source folder; the Agents window reads the copy. Reinstall: claude plugin uninstall {1}@{1} --scope {2} and claude plugin install {1}@{1} --scope {2}
agentcheck.sameNotCompared: {0}, same as the source folder (without find, sort or cmp, the cache copy was not compared)
contextHook.near: Context at {0}k tokens, near the {1}k limit. Finish the current step without starting another big one.
contextHook.over: Context at {0}k tokens, above the {1}k limit. Hand off the baton now: finish the current step, record the Next step: line and follow {{AGENT_PLUGIN_SKILL_PREFIX}}handoff. {{AGENT_PLUGIN_SKILL_PREFIX}}run worker: return RESULT: INTERRUPTED. Conductor: follow the Baton section of the skill.
window.off: 5-hour window probe off (turn it on with PLAN_RELAY_WINDOW=on): nothing to wait for
window.noSubscription: no subscription (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY): nothing to wait for
window.noReset: no resetsAt in the cache: run --read first
window.badReset: resetsAt in the cache is not a number: nothing to wait for
